question: What is the task: clustering, classification, regression, recommendation, frequent-pattern mining, or other?
answer_evidence: Primary: Supervised 6-class ordinal classification (LOS A..F at exact t+30m) & binary severe-congestion warning (LOS E/F at t+30m). Supporting unsupervised tasks: Directed Line-Graph PageRank, 7D K-Means behavioral clustering (k=6), and SON/FPGrowth co-congestion mining (335 rules).

question: What are the features, and which ones are available BEFORE the target/outcome occurs?
answer_evidence: 23D feature vector at origin t: 7 local/lag features (<= t), 7 ICT calendar/geometry features (known at t + Train-only 3-Tier Vmax), and 9 graph/cluster/past-only prior features (strictly tau < t). Future-Shuffle Falsification (shuffling tau > t) yields max_abs_diff = 0.0.

question: What is the split/validation method? Why is it appropriate?
answer_evidence: Chronological 70/15/15 split on 7,898 exact (segment_id, slot_ts + 30m) pairs -> 5,494 TRAIN / 1,167 VAL / 1,182 TEST, with 53 boundary-straddling rows purged (train_target_cutoff_purge_verified = True) so no target label at t+30m leaks across split cutoffs.

question: What metric(s) are used? Why do they match the task?
answer_evidence: 6-Class Macro-F1 (0.5543) & Accuracy (79.82%) for overall grade fidelity; Severe ROC-AUC (0.9882) & PR-AUC (0.9593) for imbalanced early warning; plus Transition-Regime metrics on the 61 TEST cases where LOS(t) != LOS(t+30m) (Transition Detection ROC-AUC = 0.7829, PR-AUC = 0.6758, Conditional New-State Top-1 Acc = 50.51%).

question: What is the baseline or comparison?
answer_evidence: 7-model ablation on untouched TEST (1,182 pairs): Naive Persistence Baseline (LOS(t+30m) = LOS(t)), Decision Tree (14D vs 23D), Random Forest (14D vs 23D), and Binary GBT (14D vs 23D) in outputs/ablation_results.csv & outputs/transition_evaluation.csv.

question: What result would indicate the model is not useful?
answer_evidence: If the model achieved 0% accuracy on state-change windows (LOS(t) != LOS(t+30m)) like Persistence (which gets 94.84% overall accuracy due to 30m inertia but 0.00% on all 61 transitions), or if 23D features failed to improve PR-AUC over 14D on discontinuous sensor gaps (>60m).

question: What is the largest leakage / bias / evaluation risk?
answer_evidence: (1) 30-minute temporal autocorrelation (94.84% steady-state inertia) masking transition errors if only global accuracy is reported; (2) Rare severe-onset sample size (only 11 non-severe -> E/F transitions in TEST: RF catches 2/61 at tau=0.30, 9/61 at p>=0.15 with 9.48x risk lift); (3) Spatial bias (GPS covers only 11.85% of segments).
